title: Recipe
description: A delicious and fluffy vegan muffin recipe featuring fresh blueberries, creamy coconut milk, and vital wheat gluten for a superior, tender crumb. Perfect for a quick breakfast or snack.
name: Fluffy Vegan Blueberry Muffins
instructions: Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C). Line a 12-cup muffin tin with paper liners or lightly grease it.
In a large bowl, whisk together the all-purpose flour, granulated sugar, vital wheat gluten, baking powder, baking soda, and salt until well combined.

In a separate medium bowl, prepare the egg replacer by whisking the powder with the 4 tablespoons of water until smooth. Then, add the coconut milk, melted coconut oil, vanilla extract, and apple cider vinegar. Whisk until fully combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients. Mix with a spatula or wooden spoon until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; a few lumps are okay.
Gently fold in the blueberries. If using frozen, do not thaw them first to prevent the batter from turning purple.
Divide the batter evenly among the 12 prepared muffin cups. They should be about three-quarters full.
Bake for 20-24 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean and the tops are golden brown.
Let the muffins cool in the tin for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
notes: For best results, use full-fat canned coconut milk. The vital wheat gluten provides a chewier, more traditional muffin texture. To prevent blueberries from sinking, you can toss them in 1 tablespoon of the dry flour mixture before folding them into the batter.
